cuda_oxide.module_form: executable-local #[cuda_module] with libdevice-linked reciprocal RMS scaling

covered_behavior: dsv4_qkv_rms_norm_rows_kernel rows-by-two fused Q and KV weighted normalization grid

head_rms_norm_kernel in-place normalization over token-head rows

dense projection or Q8 conversion and matmul kernels
runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, or C CUDA removal
